summaries.en: U.S. President Donald Trump declared the "truce is over" with Iran following American military strikes on Iranian targets in response to attacks in the Strait of Hormuz, yet agreed to continue dialogue, leaving uncertainty about the resumption of conflict.
summaries.zh: 在美国对伊朗目标发动军事打击，以回应霍尔木兹海峡袭击事件后，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普宣布与伊朗的“休战已经结束”，但他同时同意继续对话，给未来冲突的重启留下了不确定性。
